Plate is square, roughly 26 cm across, and spans about 440 px, so ~0.06 cm/px, or about 17 px per cm.

The cauliflower pieces are three florets plus small crumbs. The largest is ~110 px, about 6 cm across, and roughly 4-5 cm tall. That is about 60 g. The second is ~100 px by 70 px, about 5 cm across, for ~35 g. The third is ~80 px, about 4 cm across, for ~25 g. Crumbs add ~5 g. Total is about 125 g, which seems a bit high, so I'll say ~110 g.

Cooked cauliflower has about 25 kcal per 100 g.
